title: Missing a Connecting Flight
paragraphs: Due to a delayed first flight, Hadi arrived at the connecting gate just as the doors were closing, watching helplessly as the plane he needed pulled away from the jet bridge without him.
Frustrated but trying to stay composed, he walked to the airline's help desk, where a staff member quickly rebooked him onto the next available flight, departing in about three hours.
Rather than wasting the time complaining, Hadi found a quiet corner, prayed Asr, and used the unexpected break to answer a few work emails he had been postponing all week.
When he finally boarded the later flight, Hadi felt oddly grateful for the delay, since it gave him a rare moment of stillness in an otherwise overly busy travel schedule.
